slices.title: Same-run resume delivery
slices.summary: Lets an answer continue the same run: a question pauses the run as awaiting_input (PendingPause kind input), /continue applies the answer as the tool result or as the stage-1 brief, and a single-use consume step stops double answers; behind AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED (default false) on top of the WS03 switches.
slices.remaining: committed e94252c1b (W2-45): AgentResume question_id 10 and answer_json 11, migration 0071 consumed_at, the recovery hold and question_expired. Re-scoped by the lead 2026-11-01: build the rest end to end with these files: ConsumeRunQuestion in orchestration.proto (single-use CAS on id, org, user, run, delivery resume, state answered, consumed_at null, with same-claim replay as ConsumeApproval) and its session-core store and handler with a real-PG two-consumer test; execute_ask_user creates a resume question when the run is eligible; the executor parks with PendingPause kind input (pause_ref question_id) and applies the answer on resume as the stage-2 tool result or the stage-1 brief; execution-core grpc.rs validators refuse question_id and answer_json unless the switch is on; the gateway /continue branch accepts question_id and answer (409 continuation_already_consumed) and emits RunPausedForInput / awaiting_input from sse_events.rs; the BFF continue body and the SPA continueRun question form plus answerQuestion for delivery resume; the AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED strict reader (default off, also requires AGENT_CONTINUE_AFTER_APPROVAL_ENABLED and EXECUTION_LOOP_RESUME_ENABLED); only then let create_run_question accept delivery resume. Also hold a run while a resume question is answered but unconsumed. Go regen, compose and the golden are lead_todo.
